destinations.name: Amboseli
destinations.description: Famous for elephant herds and iconic Mount Kilimanjaro views across open savannah plains.

destinations.name: Masai Mara
destinations.description: World-renowned reserve for big cats and the Great Migration across dramatic grasslands.

destinations.name: Lake Nakuru
destinations.description: Rift Valley park known for flamingos, rhino sanctuary protection, and scenic escarpments.

destinations.name: Tsavo
destinations.description: Expansive wilderness with red elephants, open plains, and authentic off-the-beaten-track safari drives.

destinations.name: Diani
destinations.description: White-sand Indian Ocean coastline ideal for beach holidays, snorkeling, and relaxed luxury stays.

destinations.name: Samburu
destinations.description: Northern frontier reserve with rare species, dramatic landscapes, and rich Samburu culture.

destinations.name: Mombasa
destinations.description: Historic coastal city blending Swahili culture, beaches, marine parks, and old-town heritage.

destinations.name: Wasini Island
destinations.description: Car-free coral island gateway to dolphin spotting and Kisite Mpunguti marine adventures.

destinations.name: Chale Island
destinations.description: Private coral island retreat near Diani with turquoise waters and exclusive beach luxury.

destinations.name: Watamu
destinations.description: Marine paradise with coral reefs, sea turtles, white beaches, and game-fishing experiences.

destinations.name: Mombasa North Coast
destinations.description: Lively coast with resort beaches, marine park snorkeling, and easy access to Mombasa landmarks.

destinations.name: Mombasa South Coast
destinations.description: Scenic stretch of palm-lined beaches and calm bays ideal for relaxing coastal escapes.

lodges_service_cards.note: Classic riverside and conservancy camps; strong guiding and traditional bush atmosphere.

lodges_service_cards.note: Small camps in wildlife-rich locations; good for photographers and repeat safari-goers.

lodges_service_cards.name: Tortilis Camp
lodges_service_cards.note: Kilimanjaro views and strong elephant country, and it pairs well with Tsavo or Nairobi extensions.

lodges_service_cards.note: Upper mid-range lodge inside the park with iconic mountain vistas.

lodges_service_cards.note: Star beds and conservation landscape, great with Samburu or central Kenya routing.

lodges_service_cards.name: Elephant Bedroom Camp

site_marketing_blocks.headline: Ticketing, transfers & lodges
site_marketing_blocks.body: Tambua Africa supports the full trip, not only game drives. We help clients with tickets, ground and air connections, and lodge reservations so logistics feel effortless.

site_marketing_blocks.headline: Lodge & camp booking in Kenya
site_marketing_blocks.body: We reserve safari lodges, tented camps, Nairobi and Mombasa hotels, and selected campsites according to your budget, dates, and style, then align confirmations with your tickets and transfers.
